trans_title: 塔楼：一个混凝土乌托邦
introduction: This film invites us on a guided tour led by the "Doctor", owner and designer of an incredible building located in the municipality of Limete, in Kinshasa (capital of the Democratic Republic of Congo). Designed and erected by the "Doctor" without the help of any professional architect, construction of this so far unfinished tower began in 2003.The commented visit by the "Doctor" of this planned and enigmatic construction leads us into a reflection on the heritage of modernist colonial architecture in Kinshasa, the post-social era of colonialist infrastructure, and the various utopian visions of the city. , past and contemporary.With this in mind, Baloji and De Boeck not only observe the degradation of colonial infrastructure, but they also explore the directions in which the city continues to reformulate these earlier proposals and indicate new possibilities and openings, as well as visions. utopian alternatives beyond the destruction of the material urban fabric.
